QuestInfo.0: You've escaped the Mysterious Fog, and the Nautilus is quickly gaining altitude.
QuestInfo.1: Now all that's left is to keep climbing toward the black sun. You'd better return to the White Spear.
QuestInfo.2: Just when you thought you were through the worst of it, a monstrous beast emerged from the fog, attacking and devastating the Alliance fleet.
QuestInfo.name: [Moonbridge] Clearing the Fog
